race.title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
race.verdict: ECLAIRAGE is on a good mark if Colin Keane can settle her down and gets the vote to notch a fifth C&D success. Thriving 3-y-os Firewalker and Coincidental Glory seem sure to be in the mix. ECLAIRAGE (IRE) FIREWALKER COINCIDENTAL GLORY (IRE)
